monday.title: PULL - MSU
monday.description: Calibration week: stop each set at the target RIR and log what you actually did.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Ups
exercises.description: Warm-up: 5 min easy row, then BW x5, +10 lbs x3. Rep range 6-8; full hang, chest to bar.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Chest-Supported Row
exercises.description: Rep range 8-12. Elbows 45-60 deg, 1s squeeze, chest stays on the pad.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curls
exercises.description: Rep range 10-12. Bench 45 deg, arms behind torso. Last set: drop straight to the lighter pair.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Superset A at one cable crossover (low pulleys). Rep range 12-15 per arm; cable behind the body.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Fly
exercises.description: Superset A, same station (high pulleys, cables crossed). Rep range 12-15; sweep wide, no shrug.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Pushdown
exercises.description: Same station, high pulley. Rep range 10-15; elbows pinned. Last set: drop the pin once.

tuesday.title: LEGS - MSU
tuesday.description: Calibration week; never skip the warm-up this early. Squat and RDL both in the same rack.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.description: Warm-up: 5 min bike + hip mobility, then bar x8, 95 x5, 135 x3, 165 x2. Rep range 6-8; brace every rep, at or below parallel.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.description: Rep range 8-10. Neutral spine, bar close; hinge until the hamstrings stop you.

exercises.name: Leg Extensions
exercises.description: Rep range 12-15; 1s squeeze at the top. Last set: drop the pin once.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curls
exercises.description: Rep range 10-12; hips pinned to the pad. Last set: drop the pin once.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Tri-set B in the dumbbell area. Rep range 12-15; strict, no swing.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.description: Tri-set B. Ball of foot on a plate or step, 2s pause at the bottom. Reps per leg.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raises
exercises.description: Tri-set B, on the floor. Rep range 12-20; lower back stays flat.

wednesday.title: Swim - IM Circle
wednesday.description: Technique + aerobic, 1800 yd. If short on time, cut the main set to 6x100.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.description: Easy, any stroke.

exercises.name: Drill set
exercises.description: Each 50 = 25 drill + 25 swim.

exercises.name: Main set
exercises.description: Same pace every rep, breathe every 3.

exercises.name: Kick set
exercises.description: With board, kick from the hips.

exercises.name: Cool-down
exercises.description: Very easy.

wednesday.title: Bike - Z2 Cadence
wednesday.description: Set resistance so 88-92 rpm feels Z2, and log the knob setting.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.description: Light resistance.

exercises.name: Cadence spin-ups
exercises.description: Spin-up 1 min at 105-110 rpm without bouncing; recover 5 min Z2 at 88-92 rpm.

exercises.name: Cool-down
exercises.description: Easy spin.

thursday.title: PUSH - MSU
thursday.description: Calibration week. Done by 08:30 for class.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Warm-up: band dislocates + external rotations, push-ups x15, then bar x10, 95 x5, 125 x3. Rep range 6-8; shoulder blades pinned.

exercises.name: Weighted Dips
exercises.description: Rep range 6-10. Slight forward lean; stop the set if the front of the shoulder pinches.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Rep range 8-12, 30 deg bench. Last set: drop straight to the lighter pair.

exercises.name: Cable Y-Raise
exercises.description: Tri-set A at one cable crossover (low pulleys, cables crossed). Rep range 12-15; finish just above shoulder height.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.description: Tri-set A, same station (rope, one pulley). Rep range 10-15; full stretch behind the head.

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
exercises.description: Tri-set A, same station (handle, low pulley). Rep range 10-12 per arm; arm behind the torso.

friday.title: Run - Threshold
friday.description: Z4 = comfortably hard. Finish with 2 more reps left in you.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.description: Start very easy.

exercises.name: Strides
exercises.description: Fast and relaxed, not a sprint; go by feel, not HR. Recover with an easy jog.

exercises.name: Main set
exercises.description: Even effort on all reps; recover with a Z1 jog.

exercises.name: Cool-down
exercises.description: Easy jog.

friday.title: Climbing - MSU
friday.description: Moderate volume; stay 1-2 grades below your max.

exercises.name: Climbing session
exercises.description: Self-paced, no limit projecting.

saturday.title: Bike - Tempo
saturday.description: Z3 = short sentences only. Log the knob setting for the tempo reps.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.description: Progressive.

exercises.name: Tempo set
exercises.description: Seated, same resistance every rep; 4 min Z2 spin between reps.

exercises.name: Steady aerobic
exercises.description: Back to Z2.

exercises.name: Cool-down
exercises.description: Easy spin.

exercises.name: Tennis practice
exercises.description: Self-directed.

sunday.title: Run - Long Z2
sunday.description: Conversational pace the whole way. Route of ~9.5-10.5 km ending at Meijer.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.description: Ease from Z1 into Z2.

exercises.name: Main aerobic
exercises.description: Steady Z2; slow down on hills.

exercises.name: Cool-down
exercises.description: Easy jog into Meijer.

sunday.title: Swim - Home
sunday.description: Aerobic, 1800 yd. Keep it smooth and finish very easy.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.description: Easy freestyle.

exercises.name: Build set
exercises.description: Each 50 builds from easy to Z3.

exercises.name: Main set
exercises.description: Same pace on all three, breathe every 3.

exercises.name: Backstroke set
exercises.description: Easy.

exercises.name: Cool-down
exercises.description: Very easy.
